summary: Iteration 27: tested the new Campaign Manager (backend routes/campaign_manager.py + frontend crm/CampaignsView.jsx). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_campaign_manager.py - 12/12 pytest cases PASSED. Verified GET /api/campaigns returns the Myntra campaign 7701ea79 with total=91, pending=91, sent=0, failed=0, daily_limit=25, status=active, no _id leak, and a message_template containing both {name} and {brand}; GET /api/campaigns/7701ea79/prospects returns 50 rows by default (total=91) sorted by rank with name/brand/title/linkedin_url/public_id/status=pending and 91 unique public_ids, ?status=pending -> 91, ?status=sent -> 0, unknown campaign -> 200 with empty list (not 404); POST /api/campaigns creates and persists a campaign (8-char id, defaults applied for empty body) verified via GET; POST /api/campaigns/{bad}/send-batch -> 404 'Campaign not found'; POST send-batch on empty test campaigns -> 200 {'sent':0,'detail':'No pending prospects left.'} with no 5xx; POST import-prospects on unknown campaign -> 404; brochure PDF exists on disk (486KB). All 4 TEST_ campaigns were deleted in teardown. Frontend: logged in at /linkedin-search with Agent@2024!, sidebar shows exactly 8 nav items (nav-dashboard/pipeline/search/contacts/messages/campaigns/company_pages/settings), Campaigns view renders campaign-7701ea79 with '91 total / 91 pending / 0 sent / 0 failed', progress bar, 'Limit: 25/day' and an enabled send-batch-7701ea79 button; 'Show Prospects' expands a 50-row table (rank 1 Anirudh Mohan / KAZO / Business Head KAZO Fashion Ltd / pending badge, name links to the real LinkedIn URL) and 'Hide Prospects' collapses it. Zero console errors, zero >=400 API calls. Send Batch was deliberately NOT clicked - a real li_at cookie is present in li_search_config so clicking it would fire real LinkedIn messages and irreversibly mark 10 prospects.

critical.issue: The PDF brochure is NEVER attached. BROCHURE_PATH is defined (line 25) but never used, and campaign.attachment_path is stored but ignored - the Voyager createMessage payload is text-only (body.text + empty attributes). The stated requirement 'personalized message + PDF brochure attachment' is not met; only a brochure URL inside the text body is sent.

Failed prospects are a dead end: on any LinkedIn error (expired cookie -> 401/403 on profile lookup) the prospect is set status='failed' permanently. Neither send-batch nor the auto-sender ever re-queues 'failed', and there is no reset/retry endpoint. One run with an expired cookie silently burns 10 (auto-sender: 5) of the 91 prospects forever.

Request blocks for the whole batch: 8s asyncio.sleep + 2 LinkedIn HTTP calls per prospect => ~90-120s for batch_size=10 and ~250s+ for 25. This will exceed the ingress/proxy timeout, so the UI will see a 502/504 while the backend keeps sending - the user gets no result and may re-click, causing duplicate sends. Batch sending must be a background task with a status/progress endpoint.

No claim/lock on prospects. The 30-min auto-sender and a manual Send Batch both select the same status='pending' rows and only flip status AFTER the message is sent, so overlapping runs can message the same prospect twice. Mark rows 'sending' (atomic find_one_and_update) before dispatch.

Recipient URN construction looks wrong and is unverifiable without a live send: mailboxUrn is built as 'urn:li:fsd_profile:' + public_id, but public_id is the vanity slug (e.g. 'anirudh-mohan-ab9b907'), not a profile id; and member_urn is matched on 'fs_miniProfile:' while the decorationId used is a *dash* profile decoration (entityUrns are 'urn:li:fsd_profile:...'). High probability every send fails or messages the wrong mailbox. Needs a verified single-recipient dry run before the 91-prospect campaign is unleashed.

minor.issue: Per-campaign daily_limit is ignored - lines 147/156/158/297 all use the module constant MAX_MESSAGES_PER_DAY (25). A campaign created with daily_limit=5 (verified persisted) will still send 25/day via the manual endpoint, contradicting the 'Limit: 25/day' label the UI reads from the campaign doc.

No mapping of LinkedIn 401/403 to a clear 'li_at cookie expired' response. Cookie presence is checked but validity is not, so an expired cookie is reported only as 'profile lookup 401' per prospect. Recommend a pre-flight cookie validation that aborts the batch with 400 instead of failing prospects one by one.
today_start = now.replace(hour=0,minute=0,second=0) does not zero microsecond, so the 'sent today' window is off by up to 1s and the daily-limit count can be marginally wrong.

Reads a hardcoded ephemeral path /tmp/prospects.xlsx with hardcoded column indices (0,1,2,13,16,17,21) and min_row=5. After a container restart the file is gone and re-import is impossible; the declared UploadFile/File import is unused so there is no upload route. Store the workbook under /app/backend/uploads and add a real upload endpoint.
No pagination (limit only, no skip/offset) and no upper bound on limit; the UI can therefore never reach prospects 51-91.
No PUT/DELETE - campaigns cannot be renamed, paused (status is written but never mutable via API) or deleted. Test data had to be cleaned directly in Mongo.

Accepts a raw `data: dict` with no Pydantic model - name/message_template/daily_limit are unvalidated (empty body creates 'Untitled Campaign', daily_limit could be a string or negative). Also `data: dict = {}` on send-batch is a mutable default argument.
Creates its own AsyncIOMotorClient with os.environ.get('MONGO_URL','') and DB_NAME default 'test_database' (repeated in every route module). Should fail fast on missing env and reuse a shared client.
The module-level Mongo handle name `client` is shadowed by the local httpx `client` inside the send loop - same fragile naming flagged in iteration 26 for voyager_auto_poster.py.

No observability: no endpoint exposes auto-sender state (last run, sent today, last error, next run). With uvicorn --reload the 600s startup delay resets on every file save, so the task effectively never fires during development and the operator cannot tell.

ui_bugs.issue: Send Batch (10) is an irreversible, destructive action (sends real LinkedIn DMs to 10 people) with no confirmation dialog, no message preview and no attachment indicator. A single stray click fires the campaign.

No loading/error state for the initial fetch failure path and no timeout on the axios send-batch POST - because the request takes 90s+ the button stays in an indefinite spinner and a proxy 504 surfaces only as the generic 'Failed' string.
sendResult is a single component-level state rendered inside every campaign card's map, so with more than one campaign the result banner appears on all cards.
Only the first 50 of 91 prospects are fetched (limit=50 hardcoded) with no 'showing 50 of 91' hint, no pagination and no status filter, so 41 prospects are invisible in the UI.
No way to create a campaign or import prospects from the UI (POST /api/campaigns and /import-prospects exist but are unreachable) - the empty state just says 'No campaigns yet' with no CTA.

Table rows, the Show/Hide toggle and the campaign name/stats have no data-testid; only the card and send button do. Add e.g. prospect-row-{public_id}, toggle-prospects-{id}, campaign-stat-{pending|sent|failed}.

integration_issues.issue: Could not be exercised end to end: a valid li_at cookie is stored, so clicking Send Batch would send real messages. The 400-on-expired-cookie path described in the request is therefore NOT reachable today (cookie exists) - send-batch will instead attempt LinkedIn calls and mark prospects failed. Verified only that the endpoint returns 404 for unknown campaigns and a graceful 200/'No pending prospects left' for empty ones.

issues: Prospect name links are #2563eb on #18181b (~2.6:1 contrast) - fails WCAG AA for body text; use a lighter blue (#60a5fa)
The 0% progress bar is an almost invisible flat #27272a strip with no '0/91' or '%' label
Stat labels total/pending/sent/failed are #a1a1aa at text-xs, borderline legibility
No message-template preview or attachment chip anywhere, so the operator cannot verify what will be sent before firing the batch
Title column is truncated with max-w-[200px] and no tooltip/title attribute

action_items: Attach the PDF: implement the LinkedIn media upload (register upload -> PUT file -> reference in createMessage attachments) using BROCHURE_PATH/attachment_path, or explicitly drop the attachment requirement and document the link-only approach
Add a 'failed -> pending' retry/reset endpoint and stop permanently burning prospects on transient cookie/LinkedIn errors
Move batch sending to a BackgroundTask/asyncio task with a progress endpoint; the current 8s-per-message loop inside the HTTP request will time out at the ingress for batch_size>=8
Add an atomic 'sending' claim (find_one_and_update) so the 30-min auto-sender and a manual Send Batch cannot double-message the same prospect

Verify the recipient URN logic with a single controlled dry run before touching the 91 prospects - mailboxUrn 'urn:li:fsd_profile:'+vanity-slug and the 'fs_miniProfile:' match against a dash decoration are almost certainly wrong
Honour campaign.daily_limit in send-batch instead of the hardcoded MAX_MESSAGES_PER_DAY
Add a confirmation modal + message/attachment preview before Send Batch, and surface 'showing 50 of 91' with pagination
Validate request bodies with Pydantic models and add PUT/DELETE for campaigns
Fix prospect-link contrast (#2563eb on #18181b) and label the progress bar
critical_code_review_comments: send_campaign_batch is a ~160-line function doing cookie handling, personalisation, URN resolution, HTTP send, DB updates and rate limiting - split into _resolve_member_urn(), _send_message() and _record_result() so the URN logic becomes unit-testable without hitting LinkedIn.
The docstring claims 'queues personalized messages with attachments' but no attachment code exists - the module's stated contract and its implementation disagree.

run_campaign_auto_sender re-imports send_campaign_batch from its own module inside the loop and calls the FastAPI route function directly; the HTTPException raised for a missing cookie is swallowed as a generic error. Extract the shared logic into a plain service function used by both the route and the scheduler.
Rate-limit state is derived from sent_at strings compared lexicographically against an ISO timestamp; store real datetimes in Mongo so range queries and indexes behave correctly.
No index on campaign_prospects (campaign_id, status, rank) - every list/count call is a collection scan; fine at 91 docs, not at scale.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 requested-scope assertions pass; 5 unexercised critical design defects found by review)

seed_data_creation: 4 throwaway campaigns (TEST_qa_campaign, Untitled Campaign, TEST_qa_empty, TEST_qa_empty2, TEST_qa_import) were created via the API and deleted in module teardown directly from Mongo. No prospects were modified; no LinkedIn message was sent.

context_for_next_testing_agent: New regression file /app/backend/tests/test_campaign_manager.py (12 tests, all pass, self-cleaning). IMPORTANT: never POST /api/campaigns/7701ea79/send-batch and never click [data-testid='send-batch-7701ea79'] - a valid li_at cookie is stored, so it sends real LinkedIn DMs and irreversibly flips prospects to sent/failed with no retry path. To test send-batch safely, create a fresh campaign with zero prospects (the tests do this). Frontend testids: nav-<view> (8 items), campaign-<id>, send-batch-<id>; prospect rows/toggle have no testids yet. The auto-sender has a 600s startup delay and re-arms on every hot reload, so it was not observed running.
rca_of_the_issue: The request expected send-batch to return 400 for an expired cookie; in reality the cookie check only tests presence, and a cookie IS present (li_search_config, profile 'Abhinav Khanna'), so the 400 branch is unreachable. An expired-but-present cookie instead produces per-prospect 401s on the Voyager profile lookup, permanently marking those prospects status='failed' with no requeue path - i.e. the failure mode is worse than a crash because it silently consumes prospects. Combined with the missing PDF attachment (BROCHURE_PATH declared, never used) and the unverified fsd_profile URN construction, the campaign is not safe to run against the 91 real prospects yet.
